Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog: Moved encounter finalization and saving into ordered background work to reduce combat-end hitches, and reduced temporary memory allocations while saving. Recorded damage values and capture order are preserved. Updated the DPS widget with a combined, centered Name column, automatically sized columns, plain damage-share percentages, and concise damage/DPS values with a decimal. The rDPS, aDPS, and nDPS column options are temporarily disabled.
